limitations: Delivery acknowledgements and the latest accepted task revision are per process and are lost on restart; acknowledgement ids are derived from receipt and adapter so a retried delivery keeps its id.
Receipts are HMAC signed with shared keys, so any holder of a key version can verify and mint receipts for that brain; key distribution is a deployment concern. A secret cannot contain a comma.
Shared task packs for another agent are not issued; a receipt verifies only for its own execution.
The verify route is not in the section 13.3 table; it is the server verifiable lookup section 11.2 requires.
A receipt proves retrieval and delivery, never comprehension by the model.
